pretreatment: cleaned ultrasonically using acetone, ethanol, and water
surface_functionalization: Single-stranded biotinylated DNA was dissolved in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and applied to the glass substrate surface. The PBS-dissolved molecules were bound to the surface by exposing the substrate to UV radiation (254 nm). Residuals were subsequently removed with a mixture of saline-sodium citrate and sodium dodecyl sulfate. Streptavidin horseradish peroxidase (HRP) complexes were diluted in PBS with 0.05% Tween (PBST) and exposed to the immobilized DNA for one hour at room temperature.
